title: Traffic event
description: One message per segment per 15-minute slot on the Service Bus queue traffic-events. Data contract: the collector validates before sending, the loader validates before inserting into raw.traffic_events (infra/sql/001_raw_tables.sql). Invalid messages go to the dead-letter queue.

event_id.description: segment_id + '_' + slot_ts. Same slot always gives the same id (idempotent).

current_speed.description: km/h. Raw TomTom value: kept 24 h only.

free_flow_speed.description: km/h. Raw TomTom value: kept 24 h only.

collected_at.description: When the collector received the response, UTC ISO 8601
